SELECT cpsm.id, cpsm.park_org_id, cpsm.goods_id, cpsm.stock_num, cpsm.average_price, cpsm.warehouse_id, cpsm.total_stock_num, cpsm.total_price, cpsm.remark, goods_type, goods_no, unit, unit_price, goods_name, cpsm.update_time FROM cus_pro_stock_manager cpsm LEFT JOIN cus_pro_goods_manager cpgm ON cpsm.goods_id = cpgm.id WHERE cpsm.deleted = 0 AND cpgm.deleted = 0
and cpsm.park_org_id = #{query.parkOrgId}
and cpsm.park_org_id in
#{item}
and goods_name like concat('%',#{query.goodsName},'%')
AND cpsm.stock_num <= min_stock
ORDER BY cpsm.create_time DESC
